title: Check verdict
description: Validates a single verification-check verdict JSON file in experiments/EXP-NNNN-slug/runs/iNN/checks/. Produced by deterministic checkers and AI reviewers; consumed by the agent loop.

id.description: Stable checker id, e.g. "p2/single-batch-overfit" (see the checker catalog).

severity.description: How a failure gates the loop: critical blocks, warning is advisory, info is context.

evidence.description: Why the verdict holds: numbers, log excerpts, file paths. Read by the AI diagnostician on failure.
